evidence.reason: The requested behavior is present at the current tip: spool-shell defines INPUT_DEADLINE_S = 300 and read_bundle uses time.monotonic plus select.select with the remaining deadline, raising ValueError('ledger bundle input deadline exceeded') when a short/partial upload stalls. The old blocking `body = sys.stdin.buffer.read(64 * 1024 * 1024 + 1)` from the finding is gone. History records the fixing commit for exactly this change.
